description: This file defines the Spring configuration class 'FundConfiguration' for setting up beans related to 'Fund' services within the Fineract project. It provides bean definitions for reading and writing 'Fund' entities, utilizing dependency injection with conditional bean creation.

classes.name: FundConfiguration
classes.description: Spring configuration class that defines beans for 'Fund' service layers, enabling dependency injection and conditional bean creation within the application context.

methods.name: fundReadPlatformService
methods.description: Defines a bean for reading 'Fund' data, instantiated if no existing bean of the same type is present.

methods.name: fundWritePlatformService
methods.description: Defines a bean for writing 'Fund' data, instantiated if no existing bean of the same type is present.
